faq.q: Which public schools are in West Cambie?
faq.a: Tomsett Elementary at 9671 Odlin Road is physically inside West Cambie; for the sample address used (9671 Odlin Road), the SD38 locator gives Tomsett Elementary and MacNeill Secondary — catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator, and SD38 has no middle school tier.

faq.q: What do the suite and small-scale multi-unit rules allow in West Cambie?
faq.a: The City states Richmond allows at least one secondary suite and/or an accessory dwelling unit per lot on covered lots, with provincial minimums of three units on lots 280 m² or less and four units on larger lots, and a Cambie Road application shows Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (RSM/XL) zoning in the Alexandra neighbourhood.

faq.q: What flood and noise matters are documented for West Cambie?
faq.a: City flood material describes a perimeter dike system designed for a 1:500 event with dike raising from 3.5 metres to 4.7 metres city-wide, all lands are designated flood plain under Bylaw No. 8204, and the Area Plan states West Cambie is affected by aircraft noise from Vancouver International Airport with no new single-family development permitted in Alexandra under the Aircraft Noise Sensitive Development Policy.

faq.q: What plan covers West Cambie, and is a new project listed?
faq.a: The West Cambie Area Plan is Schedule 2.11A to the Official Community Plan, under the city-wide 2041 OCP, Bylaw 9000; a rezoning application at 9720 Cambie Road for an apartment is documented as an application, not as an approved project or presale.
